cohort: 783,406 Korean women who gave birth between 2006 and 2015
finding: Prepregnancy waist circumference was strongly associated with several maternal complications, including eclampsia/preeclampsia, cesarean section, PCOS, and PROM, in a similar way to prepregnancy BMI.
mod_finding: The incidence of caesarean section increased with higher pre-pregnancy BMI and waist circumference.
